label: 2024 presidential county reference
method: Copy the existing national dashboard's 67 whole-county integer aggregates without spatial vote allocation.
limitations: Whole-county integer totals copied from the national dashboard's 2024 presidential source. RDH allocates central ballots within counties; that source qualification is preserved. No new spatial allocation, precinct interpolation, or district split is applied. Historical context, not a forecast or current race returns.
RDH allocated centrally reported county/Judicial Division votes by each candidate’s election-day precinct share.
Boundaries combine older precinct files, county maps, and December 2024 voter-file checks; some counties lacked updated official maps.
The unsplit source preserves House votes removed from the separate district-split layer; no split-layer vote removal is applied.
Historical context only: 2024 presidential returns are not 2026 race returns or a validated model baseline.
Historical precinct identifiers and names have not been validated against 2026 reporting boundaries. Never attach live votes based only on a name match.
The all_prec layer does not encode precise precinct/district splits. Preserved 2024 House contests are source returns only and are not reallocated into 2026 districts.

County and state sums reconcile to this source layer; separately reported independent official state-total comparisons do not certify precinct allocations. total_votes means all source-listed candidate votes, not ballots cast, turnout, undervotes or overvotes.

source_provenance.provider: Redistricting Data Hub (RDH), local Election-Maps copy
source_provenance.transformation: one source row to one output unit; exact integer presidential candidate sums to county (where source identifies county) and state; no spatial vote allocation

reference.provider: Federal Election Commission, state-reported presidential results

official_state_reconciliation.scope: Independent statewide candidate/total comparison only; no precinct-level certification, geography validation, source allocation reversal, or adjustments to raw/derived vote counts.
